[SWS_DM_01095] Monitor initialization for enable condition not fulfilled or ControlDTCSetting set to Off
⌈
In case an enable condition mapped to the
diagnostic event was changed to not fulfilled or DTC-setting is disabled via the
UDS service request ControlDTCSetting - 0x85 set to Off (see ISO 14229-1[1]), the
DM shall call the registered notifier method (either
- initMonitor (for Monitor-internal debouncing) or
- initMonitor (for counter-based debouncing) or
- initMonitor (for time-based debouncing)
) with the parameter ara::diag::InitMonitorReason set to kDisabled.
⌋
